audit_status.source_base: Hebrew/Aramaic source via Sefaria with source/English versification reconciliation; public-domain KJV familiar comparison
audit_status.review_note: Draft restoration of Ezra 10 follows the Hebrew witness closely; several names and a phrase (v.16) show variant/uncertain readings needing witness collation.

verses.restored: Now when Ezra had prayed and confessed, weeping and prostrating himself before the house of God, a very great assembly of Israelites—men, women, and children—gathered to him; the people wept sorely.

familiar.text: Now when Ezra had prayed, and when he had confessed, weeping and casting himself down before the house of God, there assembled unto him out of Israel a very great congregation of men and women and children: for the people wept very sore.

modern.text: While Ezra prayed and made this confession, weeping and falling facedown before the house of God, a very large assembly of Israelites—men, women, and children—gathered around him, and the people wept bitterly as well.

original.text: וּכְהִתְפַּלֵּ֤ל עֶזְרָא֙ וּכְ֨הִתְוַדֹּת֔וֹ בֹּכֶה֙ וּמִתְנַפֵּ֔ל לִפְנֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים נִקְבְּצוּ֩ אֵלָ֨יו מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֜ל קָהָ֣ל רַב מְאֹ֗ד אֲנָשִׁ֤ים וְנָשִׁים֙ וִֽילָדִ֔ים כִּֽי בָכ֥וּ הָעָ֖ם הַרְבֵּה בֶֽכֶה

verses.restored: And Shechaniah son of Jehiel, of the sons of Elam (some witnesses read 'Olam'), answered Ezra: 'We have trespassed against our God and taken foreign wives from the peoples of the land; yet now there is hope in Israel concerning this matter.'

familiar.text: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered and said unto Ezra, We have trespassed against our God, and have taken strange wives of the people of the land: yet now there is hope in Israel concerning this thing.

notes.title: variant
notes.body: Some manuscripts read a different tribal-name (עולם vs עֵילָם).

modern.text: Then Shecaniah son of Jehiel, an Elamite, said to Ezra: “We have been unfaithful to our God by marrying foreign women from the people of the land, yet in spite of this, there is hope for Israel.

original.text: וַיַּעַן֩ שְׁכַנְיָ֨ה בֶן יְחִיאֵ֜ל מִבְּנֵ֤י עולם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְעֶזְרָ֔א אֲנַ֨חְנוּ֙ מָעַ֣לְנוּ בֵאלֹהֵ֔ינוּ וַנֹּ֛שֶׁב נָשִׁ֥ים נָכְרִיּ֖וֹת מֵעַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ וְעַתָּ֛ה יֵשׁ מִקְוֶ֥ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַל זֹֽאת

verses.restored: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the foreign wives and the children born to them—by the counsel of my lord and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God—and let it be done according to the law.

familiar.text: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives, and such as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, and of those that tremble at the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the law.

modern.text: So now let us make a covenant before our God to send away all the foreign wives and their children, according to the counsel of my lord and of those who tremble at the command of our God. Let it be done according to the Law.

original.text: וְעַתָּ֣ה נִֽכְרָת בְּרִ֣ית לֵ֠אלֹהֵינוּ לְהוֹצִ֨יא כָל נָשִׁ֜ים וְהַנּוֹלָ֤ד מֵהֶם֙ בַּעֲצַ֣ת אֲדֹנָ֔י וְהַחֲרֵדִ֖ים בְּמִצְוַ֣ת אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְכַתּוֹרָ֖ה יֵעָשֶֽׂה

verses.restored: Arise; for this matter belongs to you—be strong; we are with you: act.

familiar.text: Arise; for this matter belongeth unto thee: we also will be with thee: be of good courage, and do it.

modern.text: Get up, for this matter is your responsibility, and we will support you. Be strong and take action!”

original.text: ק֛וּם כִּֽי עָלֶ֥יךָ הַדָּבָ֖ר וַאֲנַ֣חְנוּ עִמָּ֑ךְ חֲזַ֖ק וַעֲשֵֽׂה

verses.restored: Then Ezra rose and caused the chief priests, the Levites, and all Israel to swear that they would do according to this word; and they swore.

familiar.text: Then arose Ezra, and made the chief priests, the Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they should do according to this word. And they sware.

modern.text: So Ezra got up and made the leading priests, Levites, and all Israel take an oath to do what had been said. And they took the oath. The People’s Confession of Sin

original.text: וַיָּ֣קָם עֶזְרָ֡א וַיַּשְׁבַּ֣ע אֶת שָׂרֵי֩ הַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים הַלְוִיִּ֜ם וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לַעֲשׂ֛וֹת כַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה וַיִּשָּׁבֵֽעוּ

verses.restored: Ezra rose from before the house of God and went into the chamber of Johanan son of Eliashib. There he ate no bread and drank no water, for he mourned over the transgression of the exiles.

familiar.text: Then Ezra rose up from before the house of God, and went into the chamber of Johanan the son of Eliashib: and when he came thither, he did eat no bread, nor drink water: for he mourned because of the transgression of them that had been carried away.

modern.text: Then Ezra withdrew from before the house of God and walked to the chamber of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. And while he stayed there, he ate no food and drank no water, because he was mourning over the unfaithfulness of the exiles.

original.text: וַיָּ֣קָם עֶזְרָ֗א מִלִּפְנֵי֙ בֵּ֣ית הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיֵּ֕לֶךְ אֶל לִשְׁכַּ֖ת יְהוֹחָנָ֣ן בֶּן אֶלְיָשִׁ֑יב וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ שָׁ֗ם לֶ֤חֶם לֹֽא אָכַל֙ וּמַ֣יִם לֹֽא שָׁתָ֔ה כִּ֥י מִתְאַבֵּ֖ל עַל מַ֥עַל הַגּוֹלָֽה

verses.restored: A proclamation went out through Judah and Jerusalem to all the exiles, that they should gather themselves together at Jerusalem;

familiar.text: And they made proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem unto all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together unto Jerusalem;

modern.text: And a proclamation was issued throughout Judah and Jerusalem that all the exiles should gather at Jerusalem.

original.text: וַיַּעֲבִ֨ירוּ ק֜וֹל בִּיהוּדָ֣ה וִירֽוּשָׁלִַ֗ם לְכֹל֙ בְּנֵ֣י הַגּוֹלָ֔ה לְהִקָּבֵ֖ץ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם

verses.restored: And whoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and elders, his property would be forfeited and he would be separated from the congregation of the exiles.

familiar.text: And that whosoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be forfeited, and himself separated from the congregation of those that had been carried away.

modern.text: Whoever failed to appear within three days would forfeit all his property, according to the counsel of the leaders and elders, and would himself be expelled from the assembly of the exiles.

original.text: וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא יָב֜וֹא לִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת הַיָּמִ֗ים כַּעֲצַ֤ת הַשָּׂרִים֙ וְהַזְּקֵנִ֔ים יָחֳרַ֖ם כָּל רְכוּשׁ֑וֹ וְה֥וּא יִבָּדֵ֖ל מִקְּהַ֥ל הַגּוֹלָֽה

verses.restored: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered at Jerusalem within three days—the ninth month, on the twentieth day—and all the people sat in the street of the house of God, trembling over the matter and because of the heavy rain.

familiar.text: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together unto Jerusalem within three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the street of the house of God, trembling because of this matter, and for the great rain.

modern.text: So within the three days, all the men of Judah and Benjamin assembled in Jerusalem, and on the twentieth day of the ninth month, all the people sat in the square at the house of God, trembling regarding this matter and because of the heavy rain.

original.text: וַיִּקָּבְצ֣וּ כָל אַנְשֵֽׁי יְהוּדָה֩ וּבִנְיָמִ֨ן יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם לִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת הַיָּמִ֗ים ה֛וּא חֹ֥דֶשׁ הַתְּשִׁיעִ֖י בְּעֶשְׂרִ֣ים בַּחֹ֑דֶשׁ וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ כָל הָעָ֗ם בִּרְחוֹב֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים מַרְעִידִ֥ים עַל הַדָּבָ֖ר וּמֵהַגְּשָׁמִֽים

verses.restored: And Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, 'You have transgressed and taken foreign wives to increase the trespass of Israel.'

familiar.text: And Ezra the priest stood up, and said unto them, Ye have transgressed, and have taken strange wives, to increase the trespass of Israel.

modern.text: Then Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, “You have been unfaithful by marrying foreign women, adding to the guilt of Israel.

original.text: וַיָּ֨קָם עֶזְרָ֤א הַכֹּהֵן֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אַתֶּ֣ם מְעַלְתֶּ֔ם וַתֹּשִׁ֖יבוּ נָשִׁ֣ים נָכְרִיּ֑וֹת לְהוֹסִ֖יף עַל אַשְׁמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Now therefore make confession to YHWH, the God of your fathers, and do his will; separate yourselves from the peoples of the land and from the foreign wives.'

familiar.text: Now therefore make confession unto the LORD God of your fathers, and do his pleasure: and separate yourselves from the people of the land, and from the strange wives.

modern.text: Now, therefore, make a confession to the LORD, the God of your fathers, and do His will. Separate yourselves from the people of the land and from your foreign wives.”

original.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה תְּנ֥וּ תוֹדָ֛ה לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם וַעֲשׂ֣וּ רְצוֹנ֑וֹ וְהִבָּֽדְלוּ֙ מֵעַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וּמִן הַנָּשִׁ֖ים הַנָּכְרִיּֽוֹת

verses.restored: All the congregation answered with a loud voice, 'As you have said, so must we do.'

familiar.text: Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice, As thou hast said, so must we do.

modern.text: And the whole assembly responded in a loud voice: “Truly we must do as you say!

original.text: וַיַּֽעְנ֧וּ כָֽל הַקָּהָ֛ל וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ ק֣וֹל גָּד֑וֹל כֵּ֛ן כדבריך עָלֵ֖ינוּ לַעֲשֽׂוֹת

verses.restored: But the people were many, and it was the rainy season; they lacked strength to stand outside, and the work was not for one or two days—because we have increased in this trespass.

familiar.text: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand without, neither is this a work of one day or two: for we are many that have transgressed in this thing.

modern.text: But there are many people here, and it is the rainy season. We are not able to stay out in the open. Nor is this the work of one or two days, for we have transgressed greatly in this matter.

original.text: אֲבָ֞ל הָעָ֥ם רָב֙ וְהָעֵ֣ת גְּשָׁמִ֔ים וְאֵ֥ין כֹּ֖חַ לַעֲמ֣וֹד בַּח֑וּץ וְהַמְּלָאכָ֗ה לֹֽא לְי֤וֹם אֶחָד֙ וְלֹ֣א לִשְׁנַ֔יִם כִּֽי הִרְבִּ֥ינוּ לִפְשֹׁ֖עַ בַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: Let now our rulers of the whole congregation stand, and let all who have taken foreign wives in our cities come at appointed times, with the elders and judges of each city, until the fierce anger of our God over this matter turn from us.

familiar.text: Let now our rulers of all the congregation stand, and let all them which have taken strange wives in our cities come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and the judges thereof, until the fierce wrath of our God for this matter be turned from us.

modern.text: Let our leaders represent the whole assembly. Then let everyone in our towns who has married a foreign woman come at an appointed time, together with the elders and judges of each town, until the fierce anger of our God in this matter is turned away from us.”

original.text: יַֽעֲמְדוּ נָ֣א שָׂ֠רֵינוּ לְֽכָל הַקָּהָ֞ל וְכֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בֶּעָרֵ֗ינוּ הַהֹשִׁ֞יב נָשִׁ֤ים נָכְרִיּוֹת֙ יָבֹא֙ לְעִתִּ֣ים מְזֻמָּנִ֔ים וְעִמָּהֶ֛ם זִקְנֵי עִ֥יר וָעִ֖יר וְשֹׁפְטֶ֑יהָ עַ֠ד לְהָשִׁ֞יב חֲר֤וֹן אַף אֱלֹהֵ֨ינוּ֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ עַ֖ד לַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: Only Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahaziah son of Tikvah took charge of this, and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.

familiar.text: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah were employed about this matter: and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.

modern.text: (Only Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah, supported by Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite, opposed this plan.)

original.text: אַ֣ךְ יוֹנָתָ֧ן בֶּן עֲשָׂהאֵ֛ל וְיַחְזְיָ֥ה בֶן תִּקְוָ֖ה עָמְד֣וּ עַל זֹ֑את וּמְשֻׁלָּ֛ם וְשַׁבְּתַ֥י הַלֵּוִ֖י עֲזָרֻֽם

verses.restored: So the exiles did thus: Ezra the priest—men, the heads of fathers' houses in their ancestral families, all by name—were separated, and they sat down on the first day of the tenth month to set the matter (לְדַרְי֖וֹשׁ הַדָּבָר).

familiar.text: And the children of the captivity did so. And Ezra the priest, with certain chief of the fathers, after the house of their fathers, and all of them by their names, were separated, and sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.

notes.title: uncertain
notes.body: Phrase לְדַרְי֖וֹשׁ הַדָּבָר ambiguous—may mean 'to examine the matter' or include a proper name; witness check needed.

modern.text: So the exiles did as proposed. Ezra the priest selected men who were family heads, each of them identified by name, to represent their families. On the first day of the tenth month they launched the investigation,

original.text: וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ כֵן֮ בְּנֵ֣י הַגּוֹלָה֒ וַיִּבָּדְלוּ֩ עֶזְרָ֨א הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֲנָשִׁ֨ים רָאשֵׁ֧י הָאָב֛וֹת לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָ֖ם וְכֻלָּ֣ם בְּשֵׁמ֑וֹת וַיֵּשְׁב֗וּ בְּי֤וֹם אֶחָד֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִ֔י לְדַרְי֖וֹשׁ הַדָּבָֽר

verses.restored: They finished with all the men who had taken foreign wives by the first day of the first month.

familiar.text: And they made an end with all the men that had taken strange wives by the first day of the first month.

modern.text: and by the first day of the first month they had dealt with all the men who had married foreign women. Those Guilty of Intermarriage

original.text: וַיְכַלּ֣וּ בַכֹּ֔ל אֲנָשִׁ֕ים הַהֹשִׁ֖יבוּ נָשִׁ֣ים נָכְרִיּ֑וֹת עַ֛ד י֥וֹם אֶחָ֖ד לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשֽׁוֹן

verses.restored: Among the sons of the priests were found those who had taken foreign wives: of the sons of Jeshua son of Jozadak and his brothers—Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.

familiar.text: And among the sons of the priests there were found that had taken strange wives: namely, of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren; Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.

modern.text: Among the descendants of the priests who had married foreign women were found these descendants of Jeshua son of Jozadak and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.

original.text: וַיִּמָּצֵא֙ מִבְּנֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֹשִׁ֖יבוּ נָשִׁ֣ים נָכְרִיּ֑וֹת מִבְּנֵ֨י יֵשׁ֤וּעַ בֶּן יֽוֹצָדָק֙ וְאֶחָ֔יו מַֽעֲשֵׂיָה֙ וֶֽאֱלִיעֶ֔זֶר וְיָרִ֖יב וּגְדַלְיָֽה

verses.restored: They pledged to put away their wives and, guilty, presented a ram of the flock for their trespass.

familiar.text: And they gave their hands that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their trespass.

modern.text: They pledged to send their wives away, and for their guilt they presented a ram from the flock as a guilt offering.

original.text: וַיִּתְּנ֥וּ יָדָ֖ם לְהוֹצִ֣יא נְשֵׁיהֶ֑ם וַאֲשֵׁמִ֥ים אֵֽיל צֹ֖אן עַל אַשְׁמָתָֽם

verses.restored: And of the sons of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.

familiar.text: And of the sons of Immer; Hanani, and Zebadiah.

modern.text: From the descendants of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.

original.text: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י אִמֵּ֔ר חֲנָ֖נִי וּזְבַדְיָֽה

verses.restored: And of the sons of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.

familiar.text: And of the sons of Harim; Maaseiah, and Elijah, and Shemaiah, and Jehiel, and Uzziah.

modern.text: From the descendants of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.

original.text: וּמִבְּנֵ֖י חָרִ֑ם מַעֲשֵׂיָ֤ה וְאֵֽלִיָּה֙ וּֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֔ה וִיחִיאֵ֖ל וְעֻזִיָּֽה

verses.restored: And of the sons of Pashur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

familiar.text: And of the sons of Pashur; Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

modern.text: From the descendants of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

original.text: וּמִבְּנֵ֖י פַּשְׁח֑וּר אֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֤י מַֽעֲשֵׂיָה֙ יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל נְתַנְאֵ֔ל יוֹזָבָ֖ד וְאֶלְעָשָֽׂה

verses.restored: And of the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelai (called Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

familiar.text: Also of the Levites; Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah, (the same is Kelita,) Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

modern.text: Among the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (that is, Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

original.text: וּמִֽן הַלְוִיִּ֑ם יוֹזָבָ֣ד וְשִׁמְעִ֗י וְקֵֽלָיָה֙ ה֣וּא קְלִיטָ֔א פְּתַֽחְיָ֥ה יְהוּדָ֖ה וֶאֱלִיעֶֽזֶר

verses.restored: Of the singers: Eliashib; and of the porters: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.

familiar.text: Of the singers also; Eliashib: and of the porters; Shallum, and Telem, and Uri.

modern.text: From the singers: Eliashib. From the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.

original.text: וּמִן הַמְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים אֶלְיָשִׁ֑יב וּמִן הַשֹּׁ֣עֲרִ֔ים שַׁלֻּ֥ם וָטֶ֖לֶם וְאוּרִֽי

modern.text: And among the other Israelites, from the descendants of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malchijah, and Benaiah.

original.text: וּמִֽיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִבְּנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֡שׁ רַ֠מְיָה וְיִזִּיָּ֤ה וּמַלְכִּיָּה֙ וּמִיָּמִ֣ן וְאֶלְעָזָ֔ר וּמַלְכִּיָּ֖ה וּבְנָיָֽה

modern.text: From the descendants of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah.

original.text: וּמִבְּנֵ֖י עֵילָ֑ם מַתַּנְיָ֤ה זְכַרְיָה֙ וִיחִיאֵ֣ל וְעַבְדִּ֔י וִירֵמ֖וֹת וְאֵלִיָּֽה

original.text: וּמִבְּנֵ֖י זַתּ֑וּא אֶלְיוֹעֵנַ֤י אֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ מַתַּנְיָ֣ה וִֽירֵמ֔וֹת וְזָבָ֖ד וַעֲזִיזָֽא

notes.body: The chapter ends by noting some accused men had children by the foreign wives.

modern.text: All these men had married foreign women, and some of them had children by these wives.

original.text: כָּל אֵ֕לֶּה נשאי נָשִׁ֣ים נָכְרִיּ֑וֹת וְיֵ֣שׁ מֵהֶ֣ם נָשִׁ֔ים וַיָּשִׂ֖ימוּ בָּנִֽים
